compute_nn_distance: compute chamfer distance between two point clouds using nn_distance with L2 loss
compute_huber_loss: compute huber loss on point cloud differences with configurable delta threshold
compute_l1_distance: compute L1 chamfer distance between two point clouds using nn_distance with l1 flag
compute_l1smooth_distance: compute L1-smooth chamfer distance between two point clouds using nn_distance with l1smooth flag
run_nn_distance_demo: run the demo_nn_distance function to verify nn_distance implementation with sample point clouds
